title: Answer key for one app: real upstream bugs, each with a bug release and a fixed release

symptom.description: What a user sees, in plain words. No hint of the fix.

layer.description: Where the defect shows or is stored. UI only when nothing deeper is known.

feature_tags.description: App features the bug touches. The sign-in type comes from recipe.yaml and is added by the scorer.

bug_tag.description: Upstream release that has the bug. Must be a version in recipe.yaml.

fix_tag.description: Next upstream release, which has the fix. Must be a version in recipe.yaml.

fix_commit.description: Merge commit of the fix, when recorded.

compare_verified.description: true = git compare showed the fix absent from bug_tag and present in fix_tag.

bug_presence_verified.description: true = the bug was seen on bug_tag (reporter named that version, or a person saw it). false = only the fix's absence is verified.

fixed_at.description: Date the fix merged upstream. Used to prefer bugs fixed after a model's training cutoff.

split.description: Empty until the key is frozen; then dev or heldout.
